args.sql:
SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS user_id,
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate' AS content_quality_score,
    sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval' AS content_volume,
    sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount' AS follower_count,
    f.personal_attributes->'preferences'->>'occupath' AS creator_type
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    socialcommunity sc ON f.userregistry = sc.socialreg
ORDER BY 
    content_quality_score DESC, follower_count DESC;
